limits.Coff: Off-route Im(Y)/omega and external selector-plane shunt values are apparent quantities. TG is multi-terminal; off route bias, cross-admittance and cancellation are included. No unique device Coff is identifiable from these probes.
limits.DC: The collector retained rail power, not direct DC branch currents. I=-P/V applies only to nonzero-voltage rails; zero-volt gate and relative stimulus-source DC currents are unobserved. AC source currents are measured per 1 V excitation.
limits.Ron: Low-frequency small-signal effective selected terminal drop divided by reconstructed exact passive ladder endpoint current. This is not a standalone transistor OP extraction.
limits.network: Model uses independently recovered complex r3+25ohm load from bypass and 1kHz Ron. Optional shunts illustrate limitations of lumping, not a claimed physical fit or a process-corner prediction.
limits.scope: TT fixed-bias AC only. No new simulator, PVT result or transistor mechanism isolation.
